name: USAspending Federal Awards
title: USAspending Federal Awards: Contracts, Grants, Recipients
uses: GovCon BD teams researching competitor wins and incumbents
Grant seekers and consultants checking who funds what
AI agents answering who won federal money for a topic, with sourced data

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.title: Keywords
inputs.description: Optional words to match in award descriptions, e.g. ["cybersecurity"].

inputs.name: recipientNames
inputs.title: Recipient names
inputs.description: Optional company or organization names (or UEIs), e.g. ["Booz Allen Hamilton"]. Find a competitor's federal wins.

inputs.name: awardingAgencies
inputs.title: Awarding agencies
inputs.description: Optional top-tier agency names exactly as USAspending lists them, e.g. ["Department of Defense","Department of Veterans Affairs"].

inputs.name: awardType
inputs.title: Award type
inputs.description: contracts (default), idvs, grants, loans, direct_payments or other.

inputs.name: startDate
inputs.title: Start date
inputs.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days ago. USAspending data starts 2007-10-01.

inputs.name: minAmount
inputs.title: Minimum amount (USD)
inputs.description: Optional lower bound on award amount.

inputs.name: maxAmount
inputs.title: Maximum amount (USD)
inputs.description: Optional upper bound on award amount.

inputs.name: onlyNew
inputs.title: Only new since last run
inputs.description: true = skip awards delivered by an earlier run with the same filters.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.title: Max results
inputs.description: Maximum rows (1-10000). You pay per row: 100 rows = $0.15.

description: Search U.S. federal contract and grant awards from the official USAspending.gov API by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date and amount. Award amount, recipient UEI, agency and links.

inputSchema.title: USAspending Federal Awards Search: Contracts, Grants, Recipients
inputSchema.description: Returns U.S. federal spending awards (contracts, IDVs, grants, loans) from the official USAspending.gov API, one JSON row per award, largest first. Example: {"keywords":["cybersecurity"],"awardType":"contracts","startDate":"2026-01-01","maxResults":50}. Pricing: $0.0015 per award row.
